note: Session-level record. Every run in this pilot used this single machine and this single virtual environment, so this describes the software stack for all of outputs/. Per-directory provenance.json files are written only by runs executed after write_run_context() was added; the directories listed in dirs_without_own_provenance predate that change and were deliberately NOT back-stamped, because a back-stamped file would falsely imply the script captured it at run time.
